subie: subir — he was taking up (imperfect 3rd sg. in -ie, transitive; allá las subie 'he took them up there'; = las subía)
vellidos: vellido — beautiful, lovely (adjective, masc. pl.; ojos vellidos 'lovely eyes'; = bellido (archaic), hermoso)
catan: catar — they look at, gaze (present 3rd pl.; ojos … catan a todas partes 'eyes look in every direction'; = miran; modern catar means 'to taste, sample')
miran: mirar — they look at, gaze on (present 3rd pl.; miran Valençia 'they gaze on Valencia'; = miran)
yaze: yazer — it lies, is situated (present 3rd sg.; cómmo yaze la çibdad 'how the city lies'; = yace)
huerta: huerta — irrigated garden land, orchard-plain (fem.; miran la huerta 'they look on the huerta'; = huerta)
espessa: espesso — dense, thick, lush (adjective, fem. sg.; espessa es e grand 'it is thick and large'; = espesa)
alçan: alçar — they raise, lift (present 3rd pl.; alçan las manos 'they raise their hands'; = alzan)
allent: allent — beyond, on the far side of (apocopated allende; de alle[n]t partes del mar 'from beyond the sea'; = allende; also in d'allent mar)
yúcef: Yúcef — Yusuf, the king of Morocco in the poem, the Almoravid emperor (Pidal: 'emperador almorávide'; Arabic Yūsuf; = Yusuf)
pesól: pesar + le — it grieved him (preterite 3rd sg. pesó + enclitic dative le, reduced to -l; Pesól al rey 'it grieved the king'; = le pesó)
gradeçe: gradeçer — he thanks, is grateful (present 3rd sg.; non gelo gradeçe sinon a Jesu Cristo 'he thanks no one but Jesus Christ for it'; = agradece)
ajuntava: ajuntar — he was gathering, assembling (imperfect 3rd sg.; ajuntava sus virtos 'he was gathering his forces'; = juntaba)
vezes: vez — time, occasion (fem. pl.; çinquaenta vezes mill 'fifty times a thousand'; = veces)
conplidos: conplido — complete, full (past part. used as adjective, masc. pl.; todos foron conplidos 'all were complete, at full strength'; = cumplidos, completos; the exact sense is somewhat uncertain)
barcas: barca — boat, ship's boat (fem. pl.; en las barcas 'in the boats'; = barcas)
metidos: meter — put, set, embarked (past part. masc. pl. with son; en las barcas son metidos 'they have got into the boats'; = metidos)
arribado: arribar — arrived, come to shore (past part., invariable, in the perfect with an; Arribado an las naves 'the ships have come to land', naves the subject; = arribado, llegado)
conquista: conquistar — conquered (short past part. fem. sg., = conquistada, agreeing with la, i.e. Valençia; la que mio Çid a conquista 'the one my Cid has conquered'; compare conquistas = conquistadas, v. 1093; = ha conquistado; the likelier reading, the noun conquista 'conquest' not ruled out)
posan: posar — they lodge, settle, encamp (present 3rd pl.; posan las yentes descreidas 'the unbelieving host encamps'; = se alojan, acampan; modern posar 'to rest, to pose')
descreidas: descreído — unbelieving, infidel (past part. used as adjective, fem. pl.; yentes descreidas 'the unbelieving peoples', i.e. the Moors; = descreídas, incrédulas)
venidas: venir — come (past part. fem. pl., agreeing with nuevas, with ser; Estas nuevas … eran venidas 'this news had come'; = venidas)
espirital: espirital — spiritual (adjective; el Padre espirital 'the spiritual Father'; = espiritual; variant of spirital)
afán: afán — toil, hardship, labor (masc. noun; con afán gané 'with toil I won'; = afán)
muert: muert — death (apocopated muerte; a menos de muert 'short of death'; = muerte)
puodo: poder — could, was able (strong preterite, the shape of the 3rd sg., = pudo; here in the Çid's mouth, 'I could': no la puodo dexar 'I could not leave her'; an odd form, the reading not certain)
venídom: venir + me — come to me (past part. venido + enclitic dative me, reduced to -m, the accent marking the stress; Venídom es deliçio 'delight has come to me'; ser as perfect auxiliary; = me ha venido)
podré: poder — I shall be able (future 1st sg.; non lo podré dexar 'I shall not be able to leave it'; = podré)
veerme: veer + me — to see me (infinitive + enclitic me, first half of the split future ve[e]rme an 'they will see me'; = me verán; ver)
agenas: ageno — foreign, another's, strange (adjective, fem. pl.; en estas tierras agenas 'in these foreign lands'; = ajenas)
verán: veer — they will see (future 3rd pl.; verán las moradas 'they will see the dwellings'; = verán)
moradas: morada — dwelling, abode (fem. pl., from morar 'to dwell'; verán las moradas cómmo se fazen 'they will see how the dwellings are made'; = moradas; the exact sense here, 'dwellings' or 'how one makes one's dwelling', is uncertain)
afarto: afarto — abundantly, to the full, one's fill (adverb, a + farto = harto; afarto verán por los ojos 'they will see their fill with their eyes'; = hasta hartarse, de sobra)
gana: ganar — he wins, earns (present 3rd sg.; with se, passive 'is earned': cómmo se gana el pan 'how bread is earned'; = gana)
subiólas: subir + las — he took them up (preterite 3rd sg. subió + enclitic las; subiólas al alcáçer 'he took them up to the citadel'; = las subió)
alçavan: alçar — they were raising (imperfect 3rd pl.; alçavan los ojos 'they raised their eyes'; = alzaban)
quês: qué + es — what is (qué 'what' with es run together; ¿Quês esto? 'What is this?'; = ¿qué es?)
acreçe: acreçer — it increases, accrues (present 3rd sg., intransitive with dative nos; Riqueza es que nos acreçe 'it is wealth that accrues to us'; = acrece; modern acrecer is literary)
viniestes: venir — you came (preterite 2nd pl., old -stes ending; a poco que viniestes 'a little after you came'; = vinisteis)
presend: presend — gift, present (masc. noun, apocopated form of presente, with final -d; presend vos quieren dar 'they wish to give you a present'; = presente, regalo)
casar: casar — to marry off, to be married (infinitive; por casar son vuestras fijas 'your daughters are to be married'; por + inf. 'still to be done'; = casar)
adúzenvos: aduzir + vos — they bring you (present 3rd pl. adúzen + enclitic dative vos; adúzenvos axuvar 'they bring you a trousseau'; = os traen; modern aducir 'to adduce')
axuvar: axuvar — trousseau, the bride's household goods (Arabic; adúzenvos axuvar 'they bring you the trousseau', Pidal 'os traen el ajuar para el casamiento'; = ajuar)
veades: veer — you may see (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -des ending; por que me veades lidiar 'because you see me fight'; = veáis)
créçem: creçer + me — it grows in me (present 3rd sg. créçe + enclitic me, dative of the possessor; créçem el coraçón 'my heart swells'; = me crece el corazón)

__broaden__.ela: ela — the (fem. article, an archaic form, Latin illa; y ela plata 'and the silver'; = la) · also ela — it, her (fem. pronoun, Latin illa, referring to Valençia; e ela por heredad 'and it as a possession'; = ella)
__broaden__.se: se — himself/herself/itself (reflexive pronoun) · also se — passive 'is, are' (cómmo se gana el pan 'how bread is earned'; = se, passive-reflexive)
__broaden__.fazen: fazer — they make, give (present 3rd pl.; grand yantar le fazen 'they give him a great feast'; = hacen) · also fazerse — to become (cavalleros se fazen 'they become knights'; = se hacen) · also fazerse — passive 'are made' (las moradas cómmo se fazen 'how the dwellings are made'; sense of moradas uncertain)
__broaden__.metido: meter — put, cast (past part.; seré metido = 'I shall be put/cast') · also meterse — to have thrust oneself in, entered (en mis heredades … es metido 'has entered my estates', ser as perfect auxiliary)
__broaden__.poco: poco — little · also a poco que — 'shortly after' (a poco que viniestes 'a little after you came')
__broaden__.arrancar: arrancar — to drive off, rout (infinitive; a arrancar 'to be routed', passive-reflexive sense, cf. arrancada 'rout'; = ser derrotado, ahuyentado; modern arrancar 'to pull up, start') · also arrancar la lid — to win the battle, drive the foe from the field, active (yo la he de arrancar 'I must win it'; = ganar)
__broaden__.an: aver — they have (3rd pl. present of aver = han) · perfect auxiliary (passados los an 'they have passed'; la missa acabada la an 'they have finished'); an por troçir 'there remain to pass'; an ... ha far 'they have to do, are to do' · also future auxiliary after an infinitive, the split future (ve[e]rme an 'they will see me'; = me verán)
__broaden__.quiere: querer — he wants (present 3rd sg.; non lo quiere comer 'he will not eat it'; = quiere) · also 'is about to' (el março quiere entrar 'March is about to come in')
